True transparent alpha, crisp clean edges, no floor, shadows, checkerboard or glow. Camera fixed directly from the REAR, looking at the back of his head and shoulders. No face, nose, eye, front belt buckle or front white toe caps visible. Preserve spiky brown hair, golden headband with bow on screen LEFT, gold gourd held fixed in screen LEFT hand visible just past his screen-left shoulder, red small tassel, teal embroidered back vest with overlapping panels, ivory sleeves and puff trousers, jade and gold boot heels. Use the source BOTTOM row and draw these exact phases in order, left to right:

2) native f10: the screen-LEFT leg is visibly longer and its shoe sole is LOWER; the screen-RIGHT boot and puff cuff are clearly higher and visibly shortened as the foot steps away. Exactly reverse the foot-height relationship of source f7 from the top reference row. Keep the gold gourd on SCREEN LEFT and the empty hand on SCREEN RIGHT.
3) native f11: keep the screen-LEFT boot lower, shift the raised screen-RIGHT boot a little toward ground but still visibly above the left sole. The empty screen-RIGHT arm bends and rises compared with f10; opposite gourd arm tucked behind the body with its top still recognizable on screen left. Slight weight shift only; no part of the face visible.
